title: When using MiniMax M2 model in OpenAI provider, the thinking block cannot distinguish between thinking content and body text.
body:
### 📱 Client Type Web (Desktop Browser) ### 💻 Operating System Windows ### 📦 Deployment Platform Self hosting Docker ### 🔧 Deployment Mode server db (lobe-chat-database image) ### 📌 Version 1.141.10 ### 🌐 Browser Edge ### 🐛 Bug Description **When using the MiniMax M2 model in the OpenAI provider, both the body text and thinking content are displayed together in the thinking block. The image shows the display effect:** --- **Below is the original text:** --- **However, when I manually paste the original text to add an assistant message, it can distinguish them correctly.** ### 📷 Recurrence Steps 1. Modify environment variables to add the MiniMax M2 model in the OpenAI provider. 2. Ask any question using the MiniMax M2 model. 3. Observe the display effect of the assistant message. ### 🚦 Expected Behavior The thinking block should correctly distinguish between thinking content and body text. ### 📝 Additional Information I have not tried using this model in the MiniMax provider, so I don't know if the display effect is normal in the MiniMax provider. ### 🛠️ Willing to Submit a PR? No, but I am happy to help test the fix ### ✅ Validations - [x] Read the [docs](https://lobehub.com/zh/docs). - [x] Check that there isn't [already an issue](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues) that reports the same bug to avoid creating a duplicate. - [ ] Make sure this is a LobeChat issue and not a third-party library or provider issue. - [x] Check that this is a concrete bug. For Q&A, please use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions) or join our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/rGHwKq4R). --- > This issue was translated by Claude.

## Summary by Sourcery

Add MiniMax M2 and multiple new AI models to the catalog, enhance stream parsing for thinking tags, and update provider configurations for Minimax, Qiniu, and AIHubmix

New Features:
- Add MiniMax M2 chat model with expanded context window, pricing, and release settings
- Introduce a suite of siliconcloud AI chat models (Qwen3-VL-Instruct, Qwen3-VL-Thinking, DeepSeek-OCR, Qwen3 Omni variants) and Hunyuan MT 7B into the model bank

Enhancements:
- Enhance transformOpenAIStream to handle in-line </think> tags by splitting output into reasoning and text chunks
- Revamp Minimax provider configuration: clear legacy chatModels, set checkModel to M2, disable browser requests, update runtime baseURL and topP bounds
- Update Qiniu provider to use new baseURL and strip created timestamps from model listings
- Enable and update AIHubmix 'Nano Banana' model with revised identifier, description, and pricing
- Add maxOutput property to Llama 4 Maverick and prune deprecated models from Novita catalog
- Extend modelParse utils with visionKeywords for OCR support and streamline keyword matching conditions

Chores:
- Standardize displayName formatting for 'MiniMax Text 01'

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The problem involves the integration of the MiniMax M2 model with the OpenAI provider, which is related to LLM provider compatibility and incorrect model output handling—both of which are components of LLM-based agent systems.
